**A STATE-SUM FORMULA FOR THE ALEXANDER POLYNOMIAL**

*SAMSON BLACK*

8 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** We develop a diagrammatic formalism for calculating the Alexander polynomial of the closure of a braid as a state-sum. Our main tools are the Markov trace formulas for the HOMFLY-PT polynomial and Young’s semi-normal repre- sentations of the Iwahori-Hecke algebras of type A.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Semi-normal representations of Hecke algebra; 2.1 Braid group; 2.2 Iwahori-Hecke algebra; 2.3 Seminormal representations; 2.5 Sign sequences and hook partitions; 3 Construction; 4 Example; References
